title: Concept: X-Content-Type-Options present with a non-nosniff value
description: The response advertises X-Content-Type-Options but does not set nosniff. Automated header audits commonly count the presence alone, so this state passes review while the browser keeps sniffing: an uploaded file or a JSON endpoint can then be treated as HTML or JavaScript. The header only protects anything when the value is exactly nosniff.
applicability: Responses that serve user-controlled or ambiguously typed content.
risk: Content sniffing enables script execution from non-script content; LOW severity.
